Chapter 6513: It’S Rather Simple

Chapter 6513: It’s Rather Simple

Nevertheless, the food tasted worse and the beauties weren’t as attractive to him due to anxiety.

“It’s fine to let him speak.” Right said softly.

“Yes, it won’t hurt since the ultimate choice is yours.” Left nodded.

“Boss, it’s your life, we will not interfere, but if it is your decision or someone else is in charge, we must carry out our mission and promise.” Right said.

“Yes, this is your opportunity, Boss. You are not who we are looking for but you are still you so we will comply with the prior arrangement. This might not always be the case.” Left said.

“Zero consideration for me?” He glared at them.

The two exchanged glances before answering: “We can’t. Once things change, we will go to Heavenrealm.”

“Just going to treat me like air then?” He gritted his teeth.

“The real you is Longevity and Paragon, not you. It’s just that since it is your life, we won’t interfere.” Both said.

He looked dejected upon seeing this. He knew Left and Right were looking for someone else but he was the first to be born. Thus, they respected him enough not to take action.

However, once other versions took over, everything would go back to the original plan. His life was only an ephemeral part of it.

“What’s the solution?” He took a deep breath and asked.

“Simple, go to Heavenrealm.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Nonsense, everything would go back to the original trajectory or what people would call metamorphosis, I don’t need that.” He said.

“You have to trust me. I guarantee that you will still be you or Splendor Monarch, it will just be a larger playground, way more fun and exciting.” Li Qiye said.

“Well...” He had no response.

“You don’t have anything new here in Three Immortals. It’s better to change the scenery to see if you can maintain your original pursuit, wouldn’t that be a more beautiful story?” Li Qiye said.

“I suppose.” He said.

“Others can’t go to Heavenrealm even if they want to but you can have it all. Why not try?” Li Qiye continued.

“What about them?” He asked. His mind wavered slightly since he agreed that being Splendor Monarch in Heavenrealm would be a breath of fresh air.

“They can handle everything after you die. You wouldn’t care then, of course.” Li Qiye smiled.

“True.” He said.

“Wait, this is out of the question.” Left and Right said.

“Why not? He just needs to finish the rest of his life and then you two can take over. There’s no conflict.” Li Qiye said.

The two exchanged glances and Left elbowed Right: “You go.”

“You go.” Right didn’t want to start.

Left thought about it before replying: “The dead can’t be revived.”

“Can’t argue with that.” Li Qiye nodded.

“If the boss wants to finish his life without returning to the former state, it would really be over.” Right said.

“Yes, a true death, we can’t do anything then.” Left nodded solemnly.

“When he dies, I can return him to you, and not the current him but who you want him to be. That’s exactly what you’re asking of me.” Li Qiye said.

“It’s possible?” They stared skeptically at him.

“Who do you think can do this?” Li Qiye smiled.

“The villainous heaven.” They didn’t need to think.

“Yes, the villainous heaven can do it.” Li Qiye agreed: “But I’ll have you know that I can do it too. It’s a matter of whether I want to pay the price or not.”

“You can?” The two trembled and staggered backward. They thought of this before but to hear confirmation from him was something else.

They weren’t primal ancestors or overlords but actual immortals from Heavenrealm. Thus, they understood the significance of this.

They were fools in the conventional sense but their understanding of the grand dao was immaculate.

“That’s why I said it was a win-win situation. Everyone will get what they want. You will get your Longevity Paragon back.” Li Qiye said.

“Doesn’t seem problematic, win-win indeed.” Left and Right said.

“What is your price?” Splendor Monarch stared at Li Qiye.

“That’s right, if you want that thing, you can have it.” The two said in unison.

“You think too highly of it, I don’t want it.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Then what do you want?” Left and Right had no idea.

“It’s rather simple and easy, I just need you two to go release something.” Li Qiye said.

“What?” They were confused.

“There’s a place and I have a few things, you just need to toss them in when the time is right.” Li Qiye said.

“Not simple and easy at all.” Splendor Monarch had a bad feeling about this.
